title: imify policies show result
description: Written to stdout by `imify policies show --json`: the policy, its lineage and its checkpoints. The policy fields are those of `imify policies list --json`.

id.description: Policy id assigned by the API.

policy_type.description: Policy architecture, such as `act`, `groot_n1.7` or `pi0.5`. A value unknown to this CLI version passes through as sent.

state.description: Life cycle state: `queued`, `training`, `ready` or `failed`. A state unknown to this CLI version passes through as sent.

phase.description: Sub-step of the current state as sent by the API, such as `materializing`.

dataset_id.description: Id of the dataset the policy is trained on.

dataset_version_id.description: Id of the dataset version the policy is trained on.

error.description: Reason for a failed training as sent by the API, or null.

created_at.description: Creation time as sent by the API, an ISO 8601 date-time.

started_at.description: Start of training as sent by the API, an ISO 8601 date-time, or null.

finished_at.description: End of training as sent by the API, an ISO 8601 date-time, or null.

lineage.description: What the policy was trained on.

embodiment.description: Display label of the robot embodiment, such as `so100`.

episodes.description: Number of episodes in the dataset version.

episode_ids.description: Ids of the episodes in the dataset version.

id.description: Checkpoint id, such as the training step `020000`.

size.description: Total size of the checkpoint's files in bytes.

last_modified.description: Time of the last change as sent by the API, an ISO 8601 date-time.
